dct_description_sm:
This data set includes the address and geospatial coordinates of the neighborhood stations of the Service de police de la Ville de Montréal (SPVM).

See also the set [Boundary of police district post areas] (. /pdq-spvm-limits).**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
